title: 第一章 开发信篇 — 照明行业适配
content:
PURPOSE: Cold outreach to lighting distributors, electrical wholesalers, contractors, project owners, and retailers.

REGION TIPS (keep from source PDF, rewrite product to LED):
• North America: quality + time + safety; prefer business email; PayPal/TT clarity; emphasize UL/ETL/DLC and after-sales.
• Europe: quality, certificates (CE/RoHS/ERP), after-sales team, contract readiness.
• Middle East: warmer tone, more company/product detail, insert images/specs, brand & price sensitivity.
• South America / Australia: simpler English; small-order flexibility; reliability of supply.

TEMPLATE — NA/EU distributor (placeholders only):
Hi [Name],
Good day!
This is [Your Name] from [Your Lighting Company], a China LED manufacturer focused on [panel/high bay/street/flood/strip].
Our strengths: stable lm/W, complete document package (IES, packing, certs), and reliable lead time for [your market].
Below / attached are best-sellers suitable for [office/warehouse/roadway] applications. Payment can be arranged by T/T [and PayPal if you support].
May I know which categories you currently distribute?
Best regards,
[Name] | [Company] | [Web] | [WhatsApp]

INQUIRY-STYLE opener:
Hi [Name], do you supply LED high bays / street lights for projects in [country]? Are you a manufacturer or distributor?

NEW PRODUCT share: max 3 selling points + photo/spec sheet; do not invent performance numbers.

TESTIMONIAL-STYLE: only with user-approved, non-competing-market references — never fabricate.

title: 第二章 回盘篇 — 照明询盘回复
content:
RULE: For one-line price asks, take back initiative — confirm specs before firm offer.

SIMPLE REPLY:
Hello [Name],
Thanks for your inquiry. We are glad you are interested in our LED [product].
We have many variants (power, CCT, optics, driver, certificates). To recommend the right model and quote accurately, please confirm:
1) Application / mounting height
2) Power or lumen target, CCT, CRI
3) IP / dimming / sensor
4) Required certificates for [country]
5) Quantity & destination / Incoterm
As soon as we have these, we will send datasheet + quotation + lead time.
Best regards

VAGUE INQUIRY — introduce categories then ask:
Main categories: 1) Panel 2) Downlight 3) High bay 4) Street light 5) Flood 6) Strip / linear. Which matches your need? Attached company profile (when filled).

title: 第三章 报价篇 — 照明报价要素
content:
RANGE QUOTE: use when qty/specs unclear — give indicative band only if user provides real numbers; else send checklist.

FIRM QUOTE CHECKLIST (must include):
1) Incoterm + port
2) Unit price + currency
3) Quantity breaks
4) Payment terms
5) Packing / pcs per carton / CBM estimate
6) Shipping mode suggestion
7) Lead time
8) Quote validity + FX note
9) Warranty
10) Certificates included with shipment
Optional: HS code (verify), spare drivers ratio, IES availability.

Never present textile/default_domestic prices as lighting FOB.

title: 第四章 失联客户篇 — 跟进
content:
If unread: polite resend with original date + short value line (new IES / stock update / cert update).
If read no reply: ask frank blockers — price, cert, lead time, project postponed, already sourced — and offer solutions (MOQ trial, sample, alternative SKU).
Keep frequency professional; combine with useful lighting market notes rather than pure chasing.

title: 第五章 样品篇 — 灯具样品
content:
Before sample: confirm model, voltage, CCT, dimming, label language, ship-to, courier account.
Fee policy: [company placeholder]. Freight usually collect unless approved.
After dispatch: tracking + ask confirmation on arrival + test plan (lux meter, flicker, thermal, install).
Follow up after ~1–2 weeks for test feedback; offer technical support.

title: 第六章 谈价篇 — 价值与认证
content:
Shift from price-only to value: lm/W, driver lifetime, SPD, cert listing, warranty claim process, binning consistency, project documents.
Tactics from source PDF still apply: value quantification, indirect concession (freight/payment), midpoint, either-or (volume vs alternate grade), manager-assisted close — but replace silicone/fabric examples with lighting SKUs and real numbers only.

title: 第七章 收款篇
content:
After PI: repeat beneficiary bank details; warn against email fraud; ask transfer timing; call to reconfirm account for large amounts.
Soft collection: materials ready / price validity / production slot.

title: 第八章 运输篇 — 灯具出运
content:
Share closing date / ETD / ETA; send packing photos; confirm consignee & notify party early.
Documents: CI, PL, B/L or AWB, cert copies as agreed; watch destination customs sensitivity on sample values.
Pre-arrival reminder + local agent info when applicable.
Lighting-specific: lithium in emergency versions, battery docs if any; carton drop-test notes if relevant.

title: 第九章 售后篇
content:
Ask end-user or distributor: failure rate, lumen maintenance perception, installation feedback, competitor comparison, price competitiveness.
Share new SKUs / smart controls / higher-efficacy versions when relevant.
Reorder cadence tracking; holiday production cutoff notices.

title: 第十章 客诉篇
content:
Respond fast; investigate retained samples; do not casually say 'sorry' if not at fault (per source cultural note) — clarify facts, then remedy.
Collect: batch, photos, install conditions, surge/water evidence.
Close loop with corrective action in packing/QC when needed.

title: 第十一章 节假日祝福篇
content:
Keep weekend / Christmas / New Year / Thanksgiving / Halloween / Chinese festival templates from source structure.
Respect markets that do not celebrate Christmas (many Middle East).
Lighting twist: optional soft product PS only when appropriate (e.g. year-end project stocking), never spam.

title: 附录 — 照明询盘必问清单 (Inquiry Checklist)
content: Product family → Model/size → Power (W) and/or lumens → Efficacy expectation → CCT → CRI → Beam/optics/UGR → IP/IK → Driver & dimming protocol → Sensor/emergency → Voltage & frequency → Housing color → Certificates (CE/RoHS/ERP/UL/ETL/DLC/SAA/…) → Warranty years → Quantity & delivery date → Destination & Incoterm → Branding/OEM label → Packing & pallet → Special tests (LM-79, salt spray, IK) → Project docs (IES, DIALux).
